name: codex-resets
title: Codex reset history
description: Dated snapshot of Codex usage-limit reset announcements and banked reset grants from September 17, 2025 through October 11, 2026. The canonical live dataset and methodology are at https://codex-reset.com/timeline.

sources.title: Posts by Thibault Sottiaux (@thsottiaux) on X

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Stable id: the X post id, the post id plus "-banked" for the grant a reset post also gave, or the site's own id for a grant only its monitoring saw.

fields.name: type
fields.description: reset (usage limits reset for all users) or banked (a reset credit added to accounts for later use).

fields.name: announced_at
fields.description: When the event was announced, UTC (ISO 8601). For a post, its exact time from the post id.

fields.name: source
fields.description: post (an X post by @thsottiaux) or observed (the site's monitoring accounts; no post).

fields.name: post_url
fields.description: The source post on X; empty for an observed grant.

fields.name: banked_state
fields.description: For a banked grant: announced, arriving, available or unknown. Empty for a reset.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One-line English summary of the announcement.
